svg.title: edital-radar: Monitors Brazilian public tenders and surfaces the few a software vendor could realistically win. ~1,100 tenders a day; a vendor can serve maybe 3. US$0.0031: per judgment: a free local filter drops 69% of the corpus before the paid model. 0.692>0.846: recall from Haiku 4.5 to Sonnet 5, on an eval set written before the code. CI GATE: the build fails when measured quality drops, verified by breaking it on purpose. LEDGER: Langfuse cost per call reconciled exactly against an independent ledger. Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Claude API, Langfuse.
